claims.text: Toluene toxicity Tx: airway mgnt, correct met acidosis and lyte abnormalities, counsel on dangers of exposure
claims.quote: Treatment of toluene toxicity focuses on airway management, correcting metabolic acidosis and electrolyte abnormalities, and counseling the patient on the dangers of toluene exposure.

claims.text: Findings may incl hypokalemia (w ECG chgs), ↓bicarb, ↑CPK and hematuria
claims.quote: hypokalemia (with associated electrocardiogram changes), low bicarbonate, elevated creatinine phosphokinase, and hematuria.
